conviction_note: The one thing that could move this print is a second full-year raise. The Q1 短信 shows Q1 operating profit of 14.96bn, which is 57.5% of the H1 guide (26.0bn) and 29.9% of the full-year guide (50.0bn). That guide implies Q2 at 11.0bn and H2 at 12bn a quarter, both below Q1, on FX assumptions (USD 155 / EUR 180) the yen has stayed weaker than. Since Q1, machine tool orders were +60% YoY in September and FANUC beat and raised on FA/AI-semis demand on 10-23. All of that is public, though: kabutan has listed the name as a raise candidate and consensus ordinary profit (50.25bn) already sits above the 48.0bn guide. The 信用倍率 is 28.8x, and the Q1 raise gained only +1.95% on a day the Nikkei rose 4.03%. So p_up is 58 on a 3.5% scale, which gives +0.56. impact_sum (+1.0) sits close to that and agrees in sign.
bar: Company H1 guide, operating profit 26,000m (pre-tax 25,000m), and FY guide OP 50,000m / pre-tax 48,000m, set 2026-07-30 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260730/140120260730502729.pdf). Market FY pre-tax consensus 50,250m, unchanged for 4 weeks to 2026-10-28 (https://kabuyoho.jp/reportAnalyst?bcode=6471). No H1 consensus found, so print_vs_bar is against the company's H1 OP guide: Q2 at about 12.5-13bn puts H1 at about 28bn, +8%.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register 2026-10-28: 0.0%, no position at or above 0.5%, no change (baseline, https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html). 信用倍率 28.84x (kabutan, 2026-10-29, https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=6471): margin longs are crowded, so leveraged retail supply sits overhead on any rally. Goldman Sachs reported crossing 5% on 2026-10-07 and falling back below 5% on 2026-10-22 (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=6471), which reads as trading/lending inventory and not a directional holder. No options, no skew. Baseline priced_lean -0.38 (margin overhang -0.73, run-up +0.35).

findings.finding: Q1 FY3/27 operating profit was 14,961m. That is 57.5% of the H1 OP guide (26,000m) and 29.9% of the FY guide (50,000m), against a 5-year average Q1 pre-tax progress of 20.1%. The guide implies Q2 OP of only 11.0bn and H2 of 12bn a quarter, on FX of USD 155 / EUR 180, while USD/JPY ran about 156-160 through Q2 and sits at 157.9. Industrial machinery (8.1bn in Q1, segment guide 16.0bn for H1) is where the upside sits, and its end-demand kept accelerating: machine tool orders +60.4% YoY in September, and FANUC raised its FY on FA/AI-semis strength on 10-23. A second FY raise above the 50.25bn pre-tax consensus at this release is more likely than not.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Actual release dates, release-to-next-close: Q1 FY27 raise (2026-07-30, 15:30) +1.95%, while the Nikkei rose 4.03% that day. FY26 H1 raise of pre-tax 19.0bn to 29.0bn (2025-11-04) +11.76%. FY26 Q3 raise (2026-02-03) +9.21%. FY25 H1 cut (2024-10-31) -2.98%. FY27 initial guide below consensus plus the NTN merger (2026-05-12) -8.38% (Yahoo daily bars, https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/6471.T?range=3y&interval=1d).
findings.why_not_priced: The progress rate is public and kabutan named the name as an H1 raise candidate (2026-10-18), so the direction is partly held. But the stock has fallen 14% from 1,192.5 (2026-08-05) to 1,021.5 and trades at PBR 0.73 with the sector (THK -20% over the same span). Consensus ordinary has not moved in 4 weeks, at 50.25bn, only 4.7% above the guide. If the market expected a raise to the Q1 run-rate (about 55-60bn OP), consensus would sit there and the stock would not have lagged the Nikkei through October.
findings.independence: Separate sources pointing the same way: JMTBA September machine tool orders +60.4% YoY, a record for any September (Dai-ichi Life Research, 2026-10-13, https://www.dlri.co.jp/files/macro/666459.pdf), and FANUC's 2026-10-23 H1 beat, FY raise and 50bn buyback citing FA demand from AI data centres and semis in Japan and China (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=6954&b=n202610260176). FX: the company's own Q2 assumption of USD 155 is in the same revision notice (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260730/140120260730502729.pdf), so that part shares a document with the source.

findings.finding: Margin longs are crowded, with 信用倍率 at 28.84x. On the last beat-and-raise (2026-07-30) the stock gained only +1.95% on a day the Nikkei rose 4.03%, so this holder base has sold good news into strength.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2026-07-31: +1.95% on a raise, against the Nikkei +4.03% and peers NTN +4.85% and THK +9.73% the same day (Yahoo daily bars).
findings.why_not_priced: This is a reaction modifier, not a fact the price lacks: a crowded margin long caps how far a positive surprise travels, because leveraged holders sell into it. The baseline lean already carries -0.73 for it, so this finding is kept small.
findings.independence: Same-day relative reaction in Yahoo bars (https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/6471.T?range=6mo&interval=1d). Shares the margin-ratio datum with the baseline's lean component.

outside_window.finding: The NSK-NTN definitive integration agreement, with the share-transfer ratio, is due 'within about six months' of the 2026-05-12 basic agreement, so by about 2026-11-12. NTN reports 2026-10-30, a day after NSK, which makes a joint announcement inside this window possible but not likely. The direction depends on the ratio and cannot be signed.

baseline_tension: The finding leans positive while the baseline lean is mildly negative (-0.38, mostly the 28.8x margin overhang) and the 20-day run-up is -6.96%. A stock that has de-rated 14% into a likely raise cuts against the overhang. The strongest positive this release could carry is a FY raise above consensus plus a dividend increase; I looked for buybacks and found no history. The strongest negative is a held FY guide, with H2 conservatism blamed on autos or on FX at 155, landing on crowded margin longs.
lessons_applied: nothing changed: rule 1 targets negatives built on public 月次/進捗率, and my positive progress-rate finding was already sized and p_up held at 58 as partly priced; rule 2 is satisfied (the one negative is a small positioning modifier, and the strongest positive and the search for returns are written in baseline_tension); open question 4 (five-day run-in) was not used.
